integrity: Finite-field checks corroborate but do not prove all-field theorem. Originality is provisional and independent mathematical auditing has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem concerns reduced motivic classes for y²=x^{2d+1}, d≥2, and fat x-lines, not arbitrary cusps, cohomology or reducedness of representing schemes. The 2015 semigroup-cell description is a substantial prior structural antecedent; whether contact statistic was previously extracted remains a historical-priority risk. The 2025 unrefined-paper full text was unavailable. The fat-branch transfer theorem is credited to Huang--Jiang--Oblomkov.
title: Contact-refined punctual Hilbert series for every higher odd cusp
